faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.q1: How do I submit my AI tool?
faq.a1: Click the Submit Tool button in the navigation and fill out the submission form.
faq.a2: Most submissions are reviewed within 1-3 business days.
faq.q3: Can I update my tool listing?
faq.a3: Yes, log in to your dashboard and use the Update AI feature.
